# Ellen Jean Diederich Studios

> > A neo-impressionist artist's studio offering original paintings, reproductions, workshops, and curated gift items from Rancho Mirage, California.

Ellen Jean Diederich Studios showcases the work of neo-impressionist painter Ellen Jean Diederich, featuring an online gallery and store with original watercolors, fine art reproductions, painting workshops, and art-inspired products. The studio operates from Rancho Mirage, California, with strong artistic roots in Fargo, North Dakota.

## Art Gallery & Collections

- [Homepage](https://www.givinity.com): Homepage showcasing Ellen Jean Diederich's neo-impressionist paintings and workshops
- [Original Paintings](https://www.givinity.com/product-category/originals): Gallery of original watercolor and fine art paintings by Ellen Jean Diederich
- [Art Reproductions](https://www.givinity.com/product-category/reproductions): Collection of art print reproductions and digital reproductions for sale
- [About the Artist](https://www.givinity.com/about-the-artist): Biography of Ellen Jean Diederich, neo-impressionist artist and author

## Online Store & Products

- [Main Store](https://www.givinity.com/shop): Main online store featuring paintings, prints, cards, books, and gift items
- [Print-on-Demand Products](https://www.givinity.com/product-category/print-on-demand): Print-on-demand art products via Fine Art America with archival quality
- [Greeting Cards](https://www.givinity.com/product-category/cards): Greeting cards and art cards featuring Ellen Jean Diederich's paintings
- [Art Books](https://www.givinity.com/product-category/books): Collection of art books available in the online store
- [Gift Cards](https://www.givinity.com/product-category/gift-cards): Digital gift cards for purchase at Ellen Jean Diederich Studios
